directive.thread_id: work is kept in Trillion, not on disk, 2026-11-05
directive.quote: everything an AI keeps goes into his Trillion lists, never onto disk; build a judge (rules plus a classifier model) behind a hook that refuses a disk write and says which list and records:write call keeps it instead

job: refuse a tool call that writes an AI's work onto disk outside a declared repository's source, its scratch or a list copy, naming the list and the records:write call that keeps it instead
